title: Papaya and Lime Sorbet
changes_from_base: Ripe papaya and plenty of lime replace the mango; no corn syrup.
summary: A smooth coral sorbet of ripe papaya and plenty of fresh lime.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Simple syrup
steps.text: Boil the sugar and water together for 1 min, then cool completely.

steps.title: Purée
steps.text: Halve the papayas, scoop out the black seeds, spoon the flesh from the skin and blend it until smooth.

steps.title: Flavour
steps.text: Blend in the cold syrup, the lime juice and salt. Papaya is mild, so taste and add more lime if it seems flat.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Chill for 2 h, churn for 20-25 min, then freeze for 2 h. Serve with lime wedges.

tips: Choose papayas that are mostly yellow and give slightly when pressed.
Scrape the seeds out well; they taste peppery.
A pinch of chilli on top adds a nice kick.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
